mapper.select: SELECT food_id AS foodId, food_name AS foodName, count_unit AS countUnit, kcal AS kCal, carbs_g AS carbs, sugar_g AS sugar, protein_g AS protein, fat_g AS fat, sodum_mg AS sodum, trans_fat_g AS transFat, saturated_fat_g AS saturatedFat, cholesterol_mg AS cholesterol FROM food WHERE food_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{foodKeyword}, '%')

SELECT exercise_id AS exerciseId, exercise_name AS exerciseName, intensity, exercise_unit AS exerciseUnit, IF(exercise_unit = 'MIN', hour_calories_burned, count_calories_burned) AS calories from exercise_info where exercise_name like CONCAT('%', #{exerciseKeyword}, '%')

SELECT food_id AS foodId, food_name AS foodName, count_unit AS countUnit, kcal AS kCal, carbs_g AS carbs, sugar_g AS sugar, protein_g AS protein, fat_g AS fat, sodum_mg AS sodum, trans_fat_g AS transFat, saturated_fat_g AS saturatedFat, cholesterol_mg AS cholesterol FROM food limit 20

SELECT exercise_id AS exerciseId, exercise_name AS exerciseName, intensity, exercise_unit AS exerciseUnit, IF(exercise_unit = 'MIN', hour_calories_burned, count_calories_burned) AS calories from exercise_info
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO meal_record ( health_record_id, food_id, intake, meal_time ) SELECT h.health_record_id, #{foodId}, #{intake}, #{mealTime} FROM health_info h WHERE h.member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY h.health_record_id DESC LIMIT 1

INSERT INTO exercise_detail ( health_record_id, exercise_id, volume ) SELECT h.health_record_id, #{exerciseId}, #{volume} FROM health_info h WHERE h.member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY h.health_record_id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.select: select m.food_id as foodId, m.intake, m.meal_time as mealTime, f.food_name as foodName, f.kcal as calories from meal_record as m left join food as f on m.food_id = f.food_id left join health_info as h on h.health_record_id = m.health_record_id where h.member_id = #{memberId} AND date(h.record_date) = curdate() order by h.record_date desc, m.meal_time desc

SELECT ed.exercise_id AS exerciseId, ed.volume, ei.exercise_unit as exerciseUnit, ei.exercise_name AS exerciseName, h.record_date AS recordDate, IF(ei.exercise_unit = 'MIN', ei.hour_calories_burned, ei.count_calories_burned) AS calories FROM exercise_detail AS ed LEFT JOIN exercise_info AS ei ON ed.exercise_id = ei.exercise_id LEFT JOIN health_info AS h ON ed.health_record_id = h.health_record_id WHERE h.member_id = #{memberId} AND date(h.record_date) = curdate() ORDER BY h.record_date DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO health_info (member_id, record_date) VALUES (#{memberId}, CURDATE())
mapper.select: select m.food_id as foodId, m.intake, m.meal_time as mealTime, f.food_name as foodName, f.kcal as calories, h.record_date from meal_record as m left join food as f on m.food_id = f.food_id left join health_info as h on h.health_record_id = m.health_record_id where h.member_id = #{memberId} order by h.record_date desc, m.meal_time desc

SELECT ed.exercise_id AS exerciseId, ed.volume, ei.exercise_unit as exerciseUnit, ei.exercise_name AS exerciseName, h.record_date AS recordDate, IF(ei.exercise_unit = 'MIN', ei.hour_calories_burned, ei.count_calories_burned) AS calories FROM exercise_detail AS ed LEFT JOIN exercise_info AS ei ON ed.exercise_id = ei.exercise_id LEFT JOIN health_info AS h ON ed.health_record_id = h.health_record_id WHERE h.member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY h.record_date DESC
